title: 第四章 挑选功法

content_zh:
这么多年来，叶希文都不知道对方叫什么名字，不过人人都称呼他为莫老，虽不知他什么身份，但是想来也是一元宗中的前辈，所以每次叶希文见他时，都很是恭敬。
“叶小子来了？这次要看什么书啊？经史还是地理志？”莫老放下书，满是和蔼笑容的说道，对于叶希文他的观感还是很不错的，不仅谦虚有礼，更重要的是，这年头，愿意静下心看几本书的人很少了，年轻一辈都显得浮躁的很。
“莫老，我今天来是想借武技类的书！”叶希文说道。
“武技？”莫老眼中莫名精光一闪，“你过了四重？”
“不错，不错，哈哈哈！”莫老开怀的大笑，是真的将叶希文当做是子侄辈了。
“既然你是来挑选功法的，不过习武切忌不可贪多，还是要合适自己的为好！”莫老说道，虽然每一个来这里挑选秘籍的弟子，他都会这么说，但是对叶希文却是异常的认真。
很多年轻人在一开始总是想学这个想学那个，拿不定注意，甚至有些人自以为天分高绝，可以统统都学，结果最后的结果只能是画虎不成反类犬，仅仅是学了个皮毛罢了，那样的话，反而不如那些只专攻一门武技的人。
“多谢莫老提醒，小子一定谨记在心！”叶希文对莫老的话是深以为然，并且深深一鞠躬以感谢。
习武就和读书一样，没有可能一步登天，以前读书的时候，叶希文也是奉行一本读完读透了才会开始读另外一本，这样的话，可能同样都是在一定的时间内读完很多本，但是叶希文比那些几本同时学的人要通透的多了。
“好了，老头子我也不多说了，你自己进去看看吧！”莫老摆摆手，躺倒摇椅上，又看起书来。
叶希文走进了藏书阁之中，早就觉得这个莫老是深不可测，当然是指这个身份，一元宗藏书阁是何等重要的地方，怎么可能随便派一个糟老头看守就算了，连个守卫都没有，不过以前叶希文急于查清楚这个世界的情况，每次来往都是匆匆，所以也没去看这个莫老到底身上有没有什么功夫傍身，但是现在一看，却还是普通老头的样子，但是普通老头怎么可能会被派来守藏书阁，还没有其他的护卫，说明高层都很信任莫老，那么就只有一种可能了，莫老的实力根本就是深不可测，高到了他也根本看不出来的程度。
而且其身份之高也是可以料想的，只是不知道他这么高的身份为什么会甘愿来守藏书阁，虽然藏书阁在一元宗也是个很重要的地方，但是到底没有太多的实权。
不过叶希文也没去细想，反正也不是敌人，相反的，莫老对他还是非常的有好感。
一元宗的藏书阁的藏书不少，不过却分门别类的放好，其中最少的是基础和先天两种，先天级别武技是因为难以收集，而基础的武技却是没有必要太多，拳法，掌法，腿法什么的各几种就好，反正只是打基础的，将来真正对敌，用到基础武技的概率也小，打熬身子也不用那么多。
基础的武技，掌握几种就差不多了，无非就是什么基础剑法，基础拳法之类的。
所以叶希文还是将目光看向了初级武技，其中印象最深刻的毫无疑问是奔雷手，之前见过他大哥叶枫修炼的奔雷手，给他留下了深刻的印象，奔雷手最大的速度就是快，非常快，威力也非常大，不过虽然是初级，但是练至大成，威力也是颇为不弱，奔雷手练到极致每次出手之间都能引发九声雷鸣，就是奔雷九响。
叶希文没有在一楼停留而是直接就上了二楼，只见在二楼和一楼之间的楼梯之中有有一个肉眼可见的薄膜，叶希文穿了过去，只觉得一股阻力阻碍着叶希文往上走，不过叶希文还是很顺利的走了上去。
叶希文知道，这种薄膜就是为了防止实力不够的弟子硬要闯上来，虽然他上来的不算艰难，但是他却知道，这道薄膜设置的巧妙，有后天四重以上的实力的，都可以畅通无阻，没有后天四重的实力的，都是上不来的。

content_en:
For so many years, Ye Xiwen didn't know the other person's name, but everyone called him Mr. Mo. Although he didn't know his identity, he probably was a senior in the Yiyuan Sect, so every time Ye Xiwen saw him, he was very respectful.
"Young man Ye is here? What book do you want to read this time? Classics and history or geography?" Mr. Mo put down the book and said with a kind smile. He still had a good impression of Ye Xiwen. He was not only modest and polite, but more importantly, these days, there are very few people who are willing to calm down and read a few books. The younger generation seems to be very impetuous.
"Mr. Mo, I came here today to borrow martial arts books!" Ye Xiwen said.
"Martial skills?" Mo Lao's eyes flashed inexplicably, "Have you passed the fourth level?"
"Not bad, not bad, hahaha!" Mr. Mo laughed heartily, truly treating Ye Xiwen as his nephew.
"Since you are here to choose skills, you should not be greedy for too much when practicing martial arts. It is better to choose what suits you!" Mr. Mo said. Although he would say this to every disciple who came here to choose secret books, he was extremely serious about Ye Xiwen.
Many young people always want to learn this or that at the beginning, but they are not sure to pay attention. Some people even think that they are so talented that they can learn all of them. In the end, the final result can only be like a tiger instead of a dog, and they have only learned a superficial skill. In that case, they will not be as good as those who only specialize in one martial art.
"Thank you, Mr. Mo, for reminding me, I will definitely keep it in mind!" Ye Xiwen deeply agreed with Mr. Mo's words and bowed deeply to express his gratitude.
Practicing martial arts is just like studying. It is impossible to reach the sky in one step. When he was studying in the past, Ye Xiwen also followed the principle of reading one book thoroughly before starting to read another one. In this case, many books may be read in a certain period of time, but Ye Xiwen is much more thorough than those who study several books at the same time.
"Okay, I won't say any more, old man. Go in and see for yourself!" Mr. Mo waved his hand, lay down on the rocking chair, and started reading again.
Ye Xiwen walked into the library. He had long thought that Mr. Mo was unfathomable. Of course, he was referring to his identity. The Yiyuanzong library is such an important place. How could he just send a bad old man to guard it? Does Mr. Mo have any martial arts skills? But now he looks like an ordinary old man. But how could an ordinary old man be sent to guard the library? There are no other guards, which shows that the senior officials trust Mr. Mo. Then there is only one possibility. Mr. Mo's strength is simply unfathomable, so high that he can't even see it.
And his high status is also expected, but I don't know why he would be willing to guard the Library Pavilion with such a high status. Although the Library Pavilion is also a very important place in Yiyuan Sect, it does not have much real power.
But Ye Xiwen didn't think about it too much. He was not an enemy anyway. On the contrary, Mr. Mo still liked him very much.
The Yiyuan Sect's library has a lot of books, but they are placed in different categories. The least of them are basic and innate martial arts. Innate martial arts are difficult to collect, but there is no need for too many basic martial arts. Just a few of boxing, palm, and kick skills are enough. Anyway, they are just for basics. The probability of using basic martial arts against the enemy in the future is also small, and you don't need to beat the body so much.
For basic martial arts, it's almost enough to master a few basic martial arts skills, which are nothing more than basic swordsmanship, basic boxing skills, and the like.
So Ye Xiwen still turned his attention to primary martial arts. Among them, the most impressive one was undoubtedly the Thunder Hand. He had seen the Thunder Hand practiced by his elder brother Ye Feng before, which left a deep impression on him. The greatest speed of the Thunder Hand is that it is fast, very fast, and very powerful., but although it is a beginner, it is quite powerful when it is practiced to a high level. When the thunder hand is practiced to the extreme, it can trigger nine thunders every time it is shot, which is the nine thunder sounds.
Ye Xiwen did not stay on the first floor but went directly to the second floor. There was a thin film visible to the naked eye in the stairs between the second floor and the first floor. Ye Xiwen passed through it and felt a resistance preventing Ye Xiwen from going up. However, Ye Xiwen still walked up smoothly.
Ye Xiwen knew that this kind of membrane was to prevent disciples who were not strong enough to force their way up. Although it was not difficult for him to get up, he knew that this membrane was set up so cleverly that anyone with acquired strength of the fourth level or above could pass through without any obstruction. Those without the acquired strength of the fourth level would not be able to get up.
